sourceNotes.rawContent: Add a touch of ethnic glamour with this exquisite gold-toned floral nath. Adorned with shimmering red and white stones, it is a perfect high-fashion statement for weddings. To maintain its radiant luster, keep it away from moisture and perfumes, and store it safely in a dry place after use.
